resources.string: This version is a test of the build and of the map tile server. Push the button to download one map tile.
The application connects to the tile server.

The tile server sends the tile.
HTTP status: %1$d
Size: %2$d bytes
Time: %3$d ms
The tile server sends an error.\nHTTP status: %1$d\nTime: %2$d ms
This device does not trust the certificate of the tile server. The map needs its own trust store on this device. Tell the developer this result.
The application cannot show the tile as an image.
